rules.message: Customer.lastIncompleteCheckout is removed in Customer Account API 2026-10.
rules.remediation: Remove the field. There is no direct replacement in the Customer Account API; use Storefront API cart flows for active cart/checkout state or Customer.orders for purchase history.

rules.message: DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule is removed in GraphQL Admin API 2026-10.
rules.remediation: Use discountTitle and discountCode on DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.

rules.message: Shopify ScriptTag create/update operations are blocked from October 1, 2026, and storefront script tags stop running on March 1, 2027.
rules.remediation: Replace storefront JavaScript injection with an app embed block in a theme app extension; use a web pixel when the script only collects analytics or conversion data.
